parameters.content:
W08 Unbooked nurture (4.6 item 5, 4.12 last row, state-machine.md 5). Every 5 min: leads that were disclosed (first_message_at) and have no live booking.
Web / lead-ad: unbooked_nudge_2h (+2 h) -> unbooked_nudge_24h (+24 h, intro video; _text with bio_short if no video) -> unbooked_nudge_72h (+72 h, last) -> close as unbooked_closed (+24 h after the last).
CTWA stall nudges: W03 is the single owner (STALL_HOURS 1/20/68, consent question only before consent). W08 skips every lead with no broker_id (pre-routing CTWA = stop reason ctwa_pre_routing_w03; the candidate query also INNER JOINs brokers).
Template outside the 24-h window; inside it the same words go as a session interactive message. Stops on booking, STOP/opt-out, suppression, handoff, "No thanks", closed stage, 12-message cap. "No thanks" = objection: the close UPDATE and INSERT INTO suppression (smc_hash_contact(phone), source objection, note no_thanks_nurture, brand NULL = Lead Velocity-wide) run in ONE statement.
ASSUMPTIONS (needs_human): quiet hours 20:00-08:00 SAST shift a nudge to 08:00; close = last nudge + 24 h.
Idempotency: lead_activities.idempotency_key w08:{lead}:{touch} claimed with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING before any send. Logic: automation/lib/w08.mjs; tests automation/tests/W08.test.mjs.

parameters.query:
SELECT l.id, l.first_name, l.language, l.origin, l.stage, l.conv_state, l.opted_out_at, l.first_message_at, l.broker_id, l.brand_id, l.phone,
       b.contact_person, b.bio_short, b.intro_video_url,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments a WHERE a.client_id = l.id AND a.brand_id IS NOT NULL AND a.status IN ('booked','confirmed')) AS has_live_booking,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.suppression s WHERE s.mobile_hash = public.smc_hash_contact(l.phone)) AS suppressed,
       (SELECT max(c.created_at) FROM public.communications c WHERE c.lead_id = l.id AND c.direction = 'inbound') AS last_inbound_at,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM public.communications c WHERE c.lead_id = l.id AND c.direction = 'outbound') AS outbound_count,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x.payload->>'touch') FROM public.lead_activities x WHERE x.lead_id = l.id AND x.activity_type = 'nurture_sent'), '[]'::jsonb) AS sent
  FROM public.leads l
  JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = l.broker_id
 WHERE l.brand_id IS NOT NULL
   AND l.first_message_at IS NOT NULL
   AND l.first_message_at > now() - interval '6 days'
   AND l.opted_out_at IS NULL
   AND COALESCE(l.stage, 'new') NOT IN ('unbooked_closed','opted_out','disqualified','booked','confirmed','attended','no_show','dispositioned','replacement_due')
 ORDER BY l.first_message_at
 LIMIT 500;

INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, 'W08', 'system', 'nurture_sent', jsonb_build_object('touch', $4::text, 'channel', $5::text, 'template', $6::text), now(), $7)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

parameters.query:
WITH c AS (
  INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, 'W08', 'system', 'nurture_closed', '{"reason":"sequence finished"}'::jsonb, now(), $4)
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING lead_id)
UPDATE public.leads l
   SET stage = 'unbooked_closed',
       conv_state = COALESCE(l.conv_state, '{}'::jsonb) || '{"state":"closed_unbooked"}'::jsonb,
       updated_at = now()
  FROM c
 WHERE l.id = c.lead_id
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments a WHERE a.client_id = l.id AND a.brand_id IS NOT NULL AND a.status IN ('booked','confirmed'));

parameters.query:
WITH upd AS (UPDATE public.leads SET stage = $2, conv_state = $3::jsonb, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid AND opted_out_at IS NULL RETURNING id, phone),
sup AS (INSERT INTO public.suppression (mobile_hash, source, brand_id, lead_id, note)
        SELECT public.smc_hash_contact(upd.phone), $4, NULL, upd.id, $5 FROM upd WHERE $4 IS NOT NULL AND upd.phone IS NOT NULL
        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) AS updated, (SELECT count(*) FROM sup) AS suppressed;
